items.name: narration_en
items.direction: Narrate this as a popular geography YouTube Shorts channel. The Narrator is a deep, warm, confident storyteller: brisk and curious, with natural emphasis and a short comic pause before each punchline. Chars voices funny cartoon characters, short and punchy.
lines: Narrator
Your eyes aren't lying. This mountain is almost perfectly symmetric.
Narrator
So why would a volcano that erupts about every eight years stay so neat?
Narrator
This is Mayon, in the Philippines. Two thousand four hundred and sixty-two metres tall. About seven Eiffel Towers.
Narrator
And on the thirtieth of October, it erupted again, firing ash three kilometres into the sky.
Narrator
Here's the thing. Most mountains get old. Rain and wind carve them up.
Narrator
But Mayon... never gives them time.
Narrator
It has erupted around fifty times since sixteen sixteen.
Narrator
And every time, fresh rock piles up around the top. Layer... on layer.
Chars
[frustrated, whiny little raindrop, fast and exasperated] I can't erode it fast enough!
Narrator
So why is it so restless? Mayon sits on the Ring of Fire.
Narrator
Here, one tectonic plate slides under another, melts, and feeds the volcano.
Narrator
So here's the twist. Mayon isn't perfect despite its eruptions... It's perfect because of them.
Narrator
Even its name comes from Ma-gah-yon, a local word for beautiful.
Chars
[smug, vain, slow and pleased with itself, deep rumbly voice] Beauty takes work... Every few years.
Narrator
This is Bhoogol. Follow for more Geography Fun Facts.
